Best Hybrid Cameras for Travel

Why carry two cameras when one does both? These hybrids deliver professional photos AND videos without compromise.

🥇 Best Full-Frame: Sony A7C II

33MP photos, 4K60 video, and AI autofocus in a compact body. The best all-around travel camera if budget allows.

🥈 Best APS-C: Fujifilm X-T5

40MP photos with film simulations, 6.2K video, and a compact lens ecosystem. The X-T5 is a photographer's camera that happens to shoot great video.

🥉 Best Value: Panasonic Lumix S5 II

6K video, dual native ISO, and phase-detect AF. The best video-first hybrid under $2,000.
